release_notes:
Two more Ready Messages log fixes (follow-up to 1.0.73).

1. Body text nudged 4px right (padx=4 on the Text widget). In 1.0.73 the body was at x=0 of the Text widget, but the 'Ready Messages' ttk.Label heading sits 1-2px inside its own widget due to Windows ttk theme internal padding. The 4px offset brings the body flush with -- and just a hair right of -- the heading's 'R', matching the user's 'bump 1 space right' request.

2. Startup-scroll bug fixed -- all 6 log entries are now visible after restart. Root cause: _load_ready_log runs before root.deiconify(), so the Text widget is still at its tiny default height when the individual appenders call log.see('end'). That scroll position is committed at the small height; when the canvas later resizes the widget to fill the window, the old yview leaves the top 1-2 entries scrolled above the visible area. Fix: at the end of _load_ready_log, schedule self.log.yview_moveto(0) via root.after(50ms) so the scroll resets to the top after the window is fully shown. All kept entries are then visible from oldest (top) to newest (bottom).
